title: 109 West Second Street (American Legion Hall), Crookston, Polk County, MN
notes: Significance: The commercial building located at 109 West Second St., commonly known as the old American Legion Hall, was built sometime between 1880 and 1884.  The building is one of the first masonry structures on the block and may be the oldest extant building on the entire block.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 84002709
